measure.measure_definition: Binary Sher responder criterion: at least 50% reduction from preoperative baseline in the PSG-derived 4% AHI, with a final AHI below 20 events/h at the 12-month postoperative PSG.
measure.measure_name: Apnea-hypopnea index (4% AHI) responder status at 12 months (Sher criteria)

measure.measure_definition: Binary responder criterion: at least 25% reduction from preoperative baseline in the 4% ODI at the 12-month postoperative PSG. The 4% ODI counts events with a drop in oxygen saturation of at least 4%.
measure.measure_name: Oxygen desaturation index (4% ODI) responder status at 12 months

measure.measure_definition: Continuous total 4% apnea-hypopnea index in events per hour of sleep on polysomnography. Hypopneas require a 30% decrease in airflow with at least a 4% oxygen saturation drop. Baseline is the average of the two preoperative PSGs (screening and baseline); month-12 PSG is performed at fixed therapeutic settings.
